S.FORM: sua kaa-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə ia, kaʔan kaa-manəŋ ʔalam tutui.
S.PHON: sua kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə ia kaʔan kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam tutui
S.FORM: sua kaamaneng 'aram ma'akase ia, ka'an kaamaneng 'aram tutui.
S.PHON: sua kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase ia kaʔan kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am tutui
S.TRANSL: To prepare salted meat, we cannot make it out of a domesticated pig.

S.FORM: sua kaa-manəŋ-a ʔalam ma-ʔakasə ia, ʔalam vutunu, ʔalam vavulu, ʔalam takuisi, ʔalam taʔuruŋ.
S.PHON: sua kaamanəŋa ʔaɾam maʔakasə ia ʔaɾam vutunu ʔaɾam vavuɾu ʔaɾam takuiʂi ʔaɾam taʔuruŋ
S.FORM: sua kaamanenga 'aram ma'akase ia, 'aram vutunu, 'aram vavuru, 'aram takuisi, 'aram ta'urung.
S.PHON: sua kaamaneŋa ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase ia ʔa[r|ɾ]am vutunu ʔa[r|ɾ]am vavu[r|ɾ]u ʔa[r|ɾ]am takuiʂi ʔa[r|ɾ]am taʔu[r|ɾ]uŋ
S.TRANSL: To prepare salted meat, we make it out of deer meat, wild pig meat, goat meat, or muntjac meat.

S.FORM: in-maamia iisua taavalaʔ-ən kaa-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə.
S.PHON: inmaamia iisua taavaɾaʔən kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə
S.FORM: inmaamia iisua taavara'en kaamaneng 'aram ma'akase.
S.PHON: inmaamia iisua taava[r|ɾ]aʔen kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase
S.TRANSL: We made salted meat only out of the meat of those (animals mentioned above).

S.FORM: nuu tee=ci kaa-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə ia, kaa-ʔala-ʔalam-ən mati-nipi-nipi, c<əm>arəʔə tia=ma-ʔakasə masi ma-manəŋə.
S.PHON: nuu teetʂi kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə ia kaaʔaɾaʔaɾamən matinipinipi ʦəmarəʔə tiamaʔakasə maʂi mamanəŋə
S.FORM: nuu teeci kaamaneng 'aram ma'akase ia, kaa'ara'aramen matinipinipi, c<em>are'e tiama'akase masi mamanenge.
S.PHON: nuu teetʂi kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase ia kaaʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]amen matinipinipi ʦema[r|ɾ]eʔe tiamaʔakase maʂi mamaneŋe
S.TRANSL: When we prepare salted meat, we cut up meat into slices and sprinkle salt on them, then they will taste good.

S.FORM: c<in>arəʔ-an=ci ia, ala-ən=cu əm-əsəʔə na ʔuia mə-vərəka.
S.PHON: tʂinarəʔantʂi ia aɾaənʦu əməsəʔə na ʔuia məvərəka
S.FORM: c<in>are'anci ia, araencu emese'e na 'uia mevereka.
S.PHON: tʂina[r|ɾ]eʔantʂi ia a[r|ɾ]aenʦu emeseʔe na ʔuia meve[r|ɾ]eka
S.TRANSL: Having sprinkled salt on the slices of meat, we put them into a pot and cover it up.

S.FORM: nuu si-m-pusa-n=ci ia, ari-pa-piniŋ-in=cu pa-ari.
S.PHON: nuu ʂimpusantʂi ia aripapiniŋinʦu paari
S.FORM: nuu simpusanci ia, aripapiningincu paari.
S.PHON: nuu ʂimpusantʂi ia a[r|ɾ]ipapiniŋinʦu paa[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: Two days later, we take them out of the pot and dry them to the sun.

S.FORM: ni-pa-ari-an=ci ia, um-ala=ci=kia taʔatu. əm-əsəʔə ʔəna-ʔənai, ma-ala=ci=kia laŋapin.
S.PHON: nipaariantʂi ia umaɾatʂikia taʔatu əməsəʔə ʔənaʔənai maaɾatʂikia ɾaŋapin
S.FORM: nipaarianci ia, umaracikia ta'atu. emese'e 'ena'enai, maaracikia rangapin.
S.PHON: nipaa[r|ɾ]iantʂi ia uma[r|ɾ]atʂikia taʔatu emeseʔe ʔenaʔenai maa[r|ɾ]atʂikia [r|ɾ]aŋapin
S.TRANSL: Having dried them in the sun, we take them to the board on the ground, and take the bamboo slips.

S.FORM: nuu taʔiciki ra-cəkəc-ən-ni ia, əsəʔ-ən na taʔatu.
S.PHON: nuu taʔitʂiki raʦəkəʦənni ia əsəʔən na taʔatu
S.FORM: nuu ta'iciki racekecenni ia, ese'en na ta'atu.
S.PHON: nuu taʔitʂiki [r|ɾ]aʦekeʦenni ia eseʔen na taʔatu
S.TRANSL: We shall step on the slices of shoulder blade when they are left on the board.

S.FORM: pa-sa-kananapə ʔinia laŋapin ra-cəkəc-ən=cu r<um>a-ʔati-ʔatipi.
S.PHON: pasakananapə ʔinia ɾaŋapin raʦəkəʦənʦu rumaʔatiʔatipi
S.FORM: pasakananape 'inia rangapin racekecencu r<um>a'ati'atipi.
S.PHON: pasakananape ʔinia [r|ɾ]aŋapin [r|ɾ]aʦekeʦenʦu [r|ɾ]umaʔatiʔatipi
S.TRANSL: We put them on bamboo slips and step on them until they are flattened.

S.FORM: tu-rupaŋ-an=ci r<um>a-cəkəcə ia, ala-ən=cu pa-ari-in=pa.
S.PHON: turupaŋantʂi rumaʦəkəʦə ia aɾaənʦu paariinpa
S.FORM: turupanganci r<um>acekece ia, araencu paariinpa.
S.PHON: tu[r|ɾ]upaŋantʂi [r|ɾ]umaʦekeʦe ia a[r|ɾ]aenʦu paa[r|ɾ]iinpa
S.TRANSL: When we finished flattening them, we still take them to dry in the sun.

S.FORM: pa-ari-in=pa əm-əsəʔə.
S.PHON: paariinpa əməsəʔə
S.FORM: paariinpa emese'e.
S.PHON: paa[r|ɾ]iinpa emeseʔe
S.TRANSL: After drying in the sun, we put them away.

S.FORM: nuura=ci ia, pati-ʔənə-ʔən-ən=pa r<um>a-ʔatipi.
S.PHON: nuuratʂi ia patiʔənəʔənənpa rumaʔatipi
S.FORM: nuuraci ia, pati'ene'enenpa r<um>a'atipi.
S.PHON: nuu[r|ɾ]atʂi ia patiʔeneʔenenpa [r|ɾ]umaʔatipi
S.TRANSL: The next day we again flattened them.

S.FORM: makasua sua kaa-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə kisa-ən
S.PHON: makasua sua kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə kisaən
S.FORM: makasua sua kaamaneng 'aram ma'akase kisaen
S.PHON: makasua sua kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase kisaen
S.TRANSL: That is the way to prepare salted meat.

S.FORM: ŋuaci si-a-tuuturu=maku kamua makasua sua kaa-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi ʂiatuuturumaku kamua makasua sua kaamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə
S.FORM: nguaci siatuuturumaku kamua makasua sua kaamaneng 'aram ma'akase.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi ʂiatuutu[r|ɾ]umaku kamua makasua sua kaamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase
S.TRANSL: That's all I want to tell you (the process of) preparing salted meat.

S.FORM: ara-siŋsiŋ-a, susumanpai.
S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai
S.FORM: arasingsinga, susumanpai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai

S.FORM: sua ʔalam ma-ʔakasə ia, ʔapacuʔ-ai əsəʔ-ən cani vuan, u-rucini vuan, u-tulu vuan kaʔan tia=ara-aka.
S.PHON: sua ʔaɾam maʔakasə ia ʔapaʦuʔai əsəʔən ʦani vuan urutʂini vuan utuɾu vuan kaʔan tiaaraaka
S.FORM: sua 'aram ma'akase ia, 'apacu'ai ese'en cani vuan, urucini vuan, uturu vuan ka'an tiaaraaka.
S.PHON: sua ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase ia ʔapaʦuʔai eseʔen ʦani vuan u[r|ɾ]utʂini vuan utu[r|ɾ]u vuan kaʔan tiaa[r|ɾ]aaka
S.TRANSL: Salted meat won't get spoiled even if it is kept for one month, two months, or three months.

S.FORM: iimu sua ʔalam ma-ʔakasə kisa-ən ia, cu-cculu ma-manəŋ.
S.PHON: iimu sua ʔaɾam maʔakasə kisaən ia ʦuʦʦuɾu mamanəŋ
S.FORM: iimu sua 'aram ma'akase kisaen ia, cuccuru mamaneng.
S.PHON: iimu sua ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase kisaen ia ʦuʦʦu[r|ɾ]u mamaneŋ
S.TRANSL: Therefore, salted meat is really very good.

S.FORM: taavalaʔ-ən paati-a-taa-tiʔiŋ pa-camai.
S.PHON: taavaɾaʔən paatiataatiʔiŋ paʦamai
S.FORM: taavara'en paatiataati'ing pacamai.
S.PHON: taava[r|ɾ]aʔen paatiataatiʔiŋ paʦamai
S.TRANSL: Salted meat can be eaten as a side dish, a little each time.

S.FORM: iisua sua ma-manəŋ ʔalam ma-ʔakasə ŋuaci.
S.PHON: iisua sua mamanəŋ ʔaɾam maʔakasə ŋuatʂi
S.FORM: iisua sua mamaneng 'aram ma'akase nguaci.
S.PHON: iisua sua mamaneŋ ʔa[r|ɾ]am maʔakase ŋuatʂi
S.TRANSL: The goodness of salted meat lies therein.
